cues.text: Hello, thank you for calling Iris Rentals. How can I help you?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Yes, hello there. I’m ringing just to make enquiries about renting a new property and I came across a listing on your website that I’m interested in.
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: Oh yes.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: I’d like to find out a few more details, if I may.
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: Yes, of course. Can I take your name?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: It’s  Mary Collins.
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: Okay, Mary. I’m just searching our system for the  property  details.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Is there any information in particular that you were wanting?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Does the house have a gym?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: No, the house doesn’t have a gym, however the house has a large swimming pool, which will be great for exercise and really refreshing during summer.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Oh wow, that sounds lovely. What is the general layout of the house?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: This house is rather unusual as the living room is located upstairs with   the bedrooms, and downstairs at ground ﬂoor is the dining room, which has a lovely view out over the swimming pool.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Does the house come with a car parking space on the street?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: Oh, there’s no need for that. The house comes with a big Q3 garage  where you can park your cars and there’s also a lot of room for storage.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: It’s attached to the house through a door in the kitchen.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Oh, that’s perfect, it’ll make it far easier to cany my food shopping into  the house.
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: Oh yes, absolutely. You actually don’t even need to take your car to do the shopping as the local supermarket is just down the street.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: You can walk the distance easily.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Really? How convenient! Is there anywhere near to the house where I can take my children to play?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: Unfortunately there aren’t any playgrounds nearby, but there is a park near the supermarket that would be great for taking your children for a walk.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: It would also be a great place for you to meet your neighbours.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Yes, that’s true, I love taking long walks in the park.
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: I’m sure there will be a playground at the local school anyway.
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: Yes, absolutely. The community has its own primary school and there is a secondary school in the neighbouring community, so there are plenty of resources nearby for your children’s education.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: OK, great. What are the rental costs for the property?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: The monthly rent is $980, which is very reasonable considering the size  of the house and the amenities that it has to offer.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Does that figure include maintenance fees and bills?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: The bills are not included in that ﬁgure, but it does include any maintenance fees for the garden.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: That sounds like a very reasonable price. We were hoping to move in on the 20th of April.
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: Will the house be vacant for that date?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: The current tenants of the property are due to leave on the 20th, but the cleaners will need a few days to make sure that the house is clean and tidy.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: This would make the house officially available on the 23rd April.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Well everything about the house sounds perfect... exactly what I’m  looking for.
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: What date would it be possible to view the property?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: I have arranged for the tenant to leave the property on Friday so I can show the house to prospective renters.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Would you be able to make that day?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Yes, I’m sure I could come on my lunch break. Would 1 o’clock be OK?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: I’m afraid that I have a meeting at 12.30, so I won’t be able to make that time. I have available appointments at 10.15 and 3.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: OK, in that case can we schedule the appointment for 10.15?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: No problem, I’ll book it into my schedule.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: If you wouldn’t mind arriving 5 minutes early that would be great, just so we can get started on time.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Sure. What is the address?
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: The postcode is GA58ER and the house is number 8 on Spring Street.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: It’s the second right off of Bath Street.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: OK, that’s great.
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: Do you have any more questions?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Nope.. .thank you for your help.
cues.speaker: CLIENT

cues.text: No problem. See you on Friday. Bye!
cues.speaker: AGENT
